## Summary

[Partial] Locate the ECU in a donor vehicle to see if it matches your current setup. [t1044]

Compare the wiring schematics in the Factory Service Manual to identify specific wire feeds for the cluster. [t1044]

[Partial] Identify which connectors correspond to the 4wd light circuit by cross-referencing diagrams. [t1044]

Locate the factory harness and splice an aftermarket head unit harness to connect it. [t2337]

[Partial] Identify the constant power wire (yellow) to turn on the unit. [t2337]

[Partial] Identify the red wire that turns on the unit. [t2337]

Connect the remote wire (Blue) to control functions. [t2337]

Create a new ground connection as the harness does not run through it. [t2337]

Connect RCA cables to carry audio signals for four channels. [t2337]

Install a PAC SWI-RC interface module if steering wheel buttons are to be used. [t2337]

Use a precut and wired harness kit available at audio stores. [t2337]

[Partial] Locate the ABS wiring harness connector on the rear axle. [t1131]

[Partial] Reference to a heavier Group 24F Exide battery weighing around 40 pounds. [t1324]

Inspect fluid for a light shimmer and ensure spackles are small and not chunky. [t1566]

[Partial] Purchase commercial spherical bearings featuring a 5/8" inner diameter, stainless steel construction, and Teflon lining. [t1934]

[Partial] Select the COM10 size for a 5/8" inner diameter. [t1934]

Verify the material is commercial grade stainless steel and ensure the bearings are Teflon lined. [t1934]

[Partial] Install Shoreline Marine or Bosch Milspec Battery Terminals, using milled ones with extensive accessory wiring and considering protective covers. [t2100]

Locate and inspect the magnet on the drain plug assembly. [t1359]

Identify the specific size of the manual transmission drain plug. [t1359]

Identify the flasher unit type to ensure it is electronic rather than load-based. [t2114]

- Determine dimensions to find a compatible replacement part. [t1359]
